premise: Fox is the noisiest player of Rabbit's listening game — until he finally goes still and hears the tiniest sound of all: Snail whispering hello.
inspiration: The folk listening game, and the fables of the fast and boastful; turned: the quickest, loudest fox wins by learning to be still.
lesson: Being quiet lets you hear the smallest friends.

en-US.title: Fox Plays the Listening Game
en-US.text: [excited] "Listening game!" called {rabbit:enter} Rabbit. {rabbit:hop} "Sit very still, close your eyes, and say what you hear." {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to rabbit} Mouse sat down at once. {fox:enter} {fox:go to rabbit} Fox came bounding over. {fox:hop x2} "ME TOO! ME TOO!" {rabbit:live listen} Rabbit's ears went up. [whispers] "I hear… a {bee:enter} bee!" Up she buzzed, and {bee:live hum} {sfx:buzz} hummed a little tune. {mouse:live sniff} Mouse rose on tiptoe. "I hear… {sfx:grass} the grass." {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} "I hear… FOX!" shouted Fox. {rabbit:face happy} "That's just you," giggled Rabbit. Fox wiggled. {fox:live scratch} Fox scratched. Fox fidgeted. {fox:face sad} [sighs] "I can't hear anything!" "Be still as a stone," said Mouse. So Fox {fox:live listen hold} pricked up his ears and closed his eyes. Nothing. Nothing… [whispers] then the tiniest sound of all. "Hello," whispered {snail:enter} {snail:go to fox} Snail, who had been crawling up all this time. {fox:live listen resume} Fox opened his eyes. {fox:face happy} "I heard a SNAIL!" {all:face happy} {all:hop} "Fox wins!" cried Rabbit. {fox:hearts} [softly] "Shhh," said Fox, smiling. "I'm still listening."

es-ES.title: Zorro juega a escuchar
es-ES.text: [excited] —¡A jugar a escuchar! —llamó {rabbit:enter} Conejo. {rabbit:hop} —Hay que quedarse muy quieto, cerrar los ojos y decir lo que se oye. {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to rabbit} Ratón se sentó enseguida. {fox:enter} {fox:go to rabbit} Zorro llegó dando brincos. {fox:hop x2} —¡Y YO! ¡Y YO! {rabbit:live listen} Conejo levantó las orejas. [whispers] —Oigo… ¡una {bee:enter} abeja! Y allí estaba, zumbando, {bee:live hum} {sfx:buzz} tarareando una cancioncita. {mouse:live sniff} Ratón se puso de puntillas. —Oigo… {sfx:grass} la hierba. {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} —¡Oigo… a ZORRO! —gritó Zorro. {rabbit:face happy} —Ese eres tú —se rio Conejo. Zorro se meneó. {fox:live scratch} Zorro se rascó. Zorro no paraba quieto. {fox:face sad} [sighs] —¡No oigo nada! —Quieto como una piedra —le dijo Ratón. Así que Zorro {fox:live listen hold} levantó las orejas y cerró los ojos. Nada. Nada… [whispers] y entonces, el sonido más chiquitito de todos. —Hola —susurró {snail:enter} {snail:go to fox} Caracol, que llevaba todo ese rato acercándose. {fox:live listen resume} Zorro abrió los ojos. {fox:face happy} —¡He oído a un CARACOL! {all:face happy} {all:hop} —¡Gana Zorro! —gritó Conejo. {fox:hearts} [softly] —Chsss —dijo Zorro, sonriendo—. Que sigo escuchando.
